import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import (
    GradientBoostingClassifier,
    HistogramGradientBoostingClassifier,
    RandomForestClassifier,
    ExtraTreesClassifier,
)
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, RidgeClassifier, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str) and len(text.strip()) > 0:
        text = text.lower()
        if (text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"')) or (
            text.startswith("'") and text.endswith("'")
        ):
            text = text[1:-1]
        text = text.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\t", "\t").replace("\\u00a0", " ")
        text = re.sub(r"https?://\S+|www\.\S+", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r"@\w+", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r"#\w+", "", text)
        text = " ".join(text.split())
        return text
    return ""


def extract_numerical_features(text):
    """Extract engineered numerical features from text"""
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        return [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

    text = text.lower()
    text = text.replace("\n", " ").replace("\t", " ")

    chars = text.replace(" ", "")
    char_count = len(chars)
    word_list = text.split()
    word_count = len(word_list)

    special_chars = sum(
        1
        for c in chars
        if not c.isalpha() and c not in " " and c not in "\n\t" and c != ","
    )
    punct_ratio = special_chars / max(char_count, 1)

    avg_word_length = np.mean([len(w) for w in word_list]) if word_list else 0

    unique_tokens = len(set(w.strip().lower() for w in word_list)) if word_list else 0
    unique_ratio = unique_tokens / max(word_count, 1)

    return [
        char_count,
        punct_ratio,
        word_count,
        avg_word_length,
        unique_ratio,
        special_chars,
    ]


INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
train_path = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
test_path = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

train_df["clean_comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["clean_comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["clean_comment"],
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train,
    shuffle=True,
)

word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2))
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(3, 3), max_features=5000
)

X_train_full_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_full)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["clean_comment"])

X_train_full_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_full)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["clean_comment"])

X_train_full_combined = hstack([X_train_full_word, X_train_full_char])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

num_features_train = np.array([extract_numerical_features(tc) for tc in X_train_full])
num_features_val = np.array([extract_numerical_features(tc) for tc in X_val])
num_features_test = np.array(
    [extract_numerical_features(tc) for tc in test_df["clean_comment"]]
)

X_train_full_combined = hstack([X_train_full_combined, num_features_train])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_combined, num_features_val])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_combined, num_features_test])

gb_base = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=4,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
)
gb_calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(gb_base, method="isotonic", cv=3)
gb_calibrated.fit(X_train_full_combined, y_train_full)

hgb_base = HistogramGradientBoostingClassifier(
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_iter=200,
    max_bins=255,
    random_state=42,
    min_samples_leaf=20,
)
hgb_calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(hgb_base, method="sigmoid", cv=3)
hgb_calibrated.fit(X_train_full_combined, y_train_full)

lr_base = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42)
lr_calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(lr_base, method="sigmoid", cv=3)
lr_calibrated.fit(X_train_full_combined, y_train_full)

rf_base = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, max_depth=None, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42
)
rf_calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(rf_base, method="sigmoid", cv=3)
rf_calibrated.fit(X_train_full_combined, y_train_full)

et_base = ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=200, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42)
et_calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(et_base, method="sigmoid", cv=3)
et_calibrated.fit(X_train_full_combined, y_train_full)

svm_base = LinearSVC(max_iter=10000)
svm_calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(svm_base, method="sigmoid", cv=3)
svm_calibrated.fit(X_train_full_combined, y_train_full)

ridge_base = RidgeClassifier(random_state=42)
ridge_calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(ridge_base, method="sigmoid", cv=3)
ridge_calibrated.fit(X_train_full_combined, y_train_full)

# Extract base model predictions for stacking
val_pred_gb = gb_calibrated.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_pred_hgb = hgb_calibrated.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_pred_lr = lr_calibrated.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_pred_rf = rf_calibrated.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_pred_et = et_calibrated.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_pred_svm = svm_calibrated.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_pred_ridge = ridge_calibrated.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]

# Combine all base model predictions into stacked features
val_stacked_features = np.column_stack(
    [
        val_pred_gb,
        val_pred_hgb,
        val_pred_lr,
        val_pred_rf,
        val_pred_et,
        val_pred_svm,
        val_pred_ridge,
    ]
)
test_stacked_features = np.column_stack(
    [
        gb_calibrated.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1],
        hgb_calibrated.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1],
        lr_calibrated.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1],
        rf_calibrated.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1],
        et_calibrated.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1],
        svm_calibrated.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1],
        ridge_calibrated.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1],
    ]
)

# Train meta-learner on validation set
meta_learner = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42)
meta_learner.fit(val_stacked_features, y_val)

# Calculate validation AUC of stacked ensemble
val_pred_stacked = meta_learner.predict_proba(val_stacked_features)[:, 1]
print(f"Stacked Validation AUC-ROC Score: {roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred_stacked)}")

# Generate test predictions using meta-learner
test_pred_stacked = meta_learner.predict_proba(test_stacked_features)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
submission_df = test_df[["Comment", "Date"]].copy()
submission_df.insert(0, "Insult", test_pred_stacked)
output_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {output_path}")
